title: Refresh current-status review navigation through round 1800
body:
The main status page still called the fifteenth reconciliation ongoing and omitted the next three published review rounds. Refresh the four rows from their frozen review records, and link the eighteenth reconciliation as the latest recorded round. Pending contributions remain distinct from incorporated research and supplier admission.

The corrected rows report 76 merged / 24 pending, 83 / 17, 66 / 34 and 20 / 80. The seventeenth selection explicitly includes revised #2478 alongside #2716–#2828; the eighteenth mixes 42 new/revised submissions with 58 earlier follow-ups. Historical snapshots and the selected conditional result are unchanged.

Validation:

- `python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_current_status.py` — all 6 existing tests pass on Windows / CPython 3.14.6.
- Reconciled all 400 frozen selection/disposition entries with each round's `METRICS.json` and review summary; checked 24 current-section local links and byte-identical historical content.
- `git diff --check` passes.

Merge counts are the frozen observations in the linked reviews and `research/community-efficient{1500,1600,1700,1800}-audit/METRICS.json`. Round 1500's disposition file retains earlier `OPEN` GitHub-state observations; those were not treated as live merge status. No mathematical replay or new supplier/frontier claim is made by this navigation correction.

Task: `scope-navigation`, consolidation, nonce `6c8e124cce3afa17336de77273b6092e`, scope key `b18e0e173a4430a9564b`; refined to one stale onboarding route. Initial base `ffbd90dd90dbe0055464f3a1411b25a3a4fdc6b8`; rebased on refreshed canonical main `38746ad3f6ffebcc0275e286b1dbb733d7c696dd`, priority revision 5. Guidance/selection inputs were unchanged. [Coordination and bounded task](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2887) records the refreshed metadata overlap and the eight-minute cap reached by the optional full changed-file inventory; no completed path-index result is claimed.

Credit remains with the maintainer's four reconciliation records and their individually credited contributors, and the existing status-navigation/check authors. Navigation correction by Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, under Apache-2.0.
